summary: Connect OKRs, funding, capacity and delivery value across business units. Explore the five-day agile portfolio management course.
lede: Agile portfolio management helps senior PMO leaders, portfolio managers and transformation professionals connect strategic objectives to investment and delivery decisions. The training covers mapping OKRs to initiatives, prioritizing work with WSJF, allocating capacity, and making cross-team dependencies and portfolio risks visible. Through business scenarios, participants practise creating a portfolio Kanban, a capacity view and an executive report that links work to measurable outcomes.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits senior professionals who make or advise on investment, sequencing and capacity decisions across agile product and project portfolios. It is designed for roles that connect business-unit priorities with delivery evidence.
modules: Agile Portfolio Strategy and Value Streams
prerequisites: Prior experience in project, programme, product, PMO or portfolio work is expected. Familiarity with agile delivery concepts and basic budget or capacity planning will help you apply the workshop scenarios. No programming is required.
